surfaces.name: bash command gate
surfaces.kind: Claude Code PreToolUse hook on Bash that denies destructive commands, pull request merges and ad-hoc pull request creation
surfaces.driver: node --test .claude/hooks/tests/block-destructive-bash.test.mjs, then pipe PreToolUse event JSON with tool_name Bash and tool_input.command on stdin to bash .claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh with HOME set to a temporary directory, and read hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision from stdout and the exit code

surfaces.name: database gate
surfaces.kind: Claude Code PreToolUse hook on Bash and mcp__ tools that refuses live-database writes and pg credential-file access
surfaces.driver: node --test .claude/hooks/tests/db-gate.test.mjs, then pipe PreToolUse event JSON on stdin to node .claude/hooks/db-gate.mjs with HOME set to a temporary directory, and read the permission decision on stdout and the exit code

surfaces.name: permission prompt refusal hook
surfaces.kind: Claude Code PermissionRequest hook on every tool that, in bypassPermissions mode, refuses every prompt a subagent raises and every main-conversation prompt except AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode and the database gate's asks
surfaces.driver: node --test .claude/hooks/tests/refuse-unanswerable-prompt.test.mjs, then pipe PermissionRequest event JSON (permission_mode, tool_name, tool_input, and agent_id for a subagent) on stdin to node .claude/hooks/refuse-unanswerable-prompt.mjs with HOME set to a temporary directory, and read hookSpecificOutput.decision from stdout and the exit code

surfaces.name: edit and write guards
surfaces.kind: Claude Code PreToolUse hooks on Edit, Write and NotebookEdit: the config write guard, the secret scanner and the write-tools allow
surfaces.driver: node --test .claude/hooks/tests/config-write-guard.test.mjs .claude/hooks/tests/secret-scanner.test.mjs, then pipe PreToolUse event JSON with tool_input.file_path and content on stdin to each hook (node for .mjs, bash for .sh) with HOME set to a temporary directory, and read the permission decision on stdout and the exit code

surfaces.name: other PreToolUse deny hooks
surfaces.kind: Claude Code PreToolUse hooks that deny sleep loops in Bash, direct reads of task output files, and the deep-research workflow or skill
surfaces.driver: pipe PreToolUse event JSON on stdin to bash .claude/hooks/<hook>.sh (tool_name Bash with a command, Read with a file_path, Workflow or Skill with a name) with HOME set to a temporary directory, and read the permission decision on stdout and the exit code; these hooks have no test file of their own

surfaces.name: lint on edit
surfaces.kind: Claude Code PostToolUse hook on Edit and Write that runs eslint --fix on the changed file
surfaces.driver: copy a sample file into a scratch directory, pipe PostToolUse event JSON whose tool_input.file_path names that copy on stdin to bash .claude/hooks/lint-on-edit.sh, and read stderr, the exit code and the copy's contents; it has no test file of its own

surfaces.name: SessionStart hooks
surfaces.kind: Claude Code SessionStart hooks: branch sync, dotfiles link check, graphify provisioning, npm dependency audit, superpowers hook heal and plugin update check
surfaces.driver: node --test on the branch-sync, dotfiles-check and graphify test files, then from a scratch git clone of the checkout under test pipe SessionStart event JSON on stdin to each hook with HOME set to a temporary directory and cwd and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set to a scratch git repository with a local bare remote, and read stdout and the exit code; branch-sync fetches and fast-forwards both the cwd repository and the clone that holds the script, so it is never run from this checkout or the live clone

surfaces.name: Stop hook
surfaces.kind: Claude Code Stop hook: the graphify refresh
surfaces.driver: pipe Stop event JSON on stdin to bash .claude/hooks/graphify-refresh.sh with HOME set to a temporary directory and cwd and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set to a scratch git repository, and read the exit code and any graphify-out change in the scratch repository; it has no test file of its own

surfaces.name: observer hooks
surfaces.kind: Claude Code SessionEnd, SubagentStart and SubagentStop hooks that append session and subagent events to the observer log
surfaces.driver: node --test on the observer test files, then pipe SessionEnd, SubagentStart or SubagentStop event JSON on stdin to node .claude/hooks/observer/<hook>.mjs with CLAUDE_OBSERVER_DIR and HOME set to temporary directories, and read the JSONL rows it appends there

surfaces.name: npm test suite
surfaces.kind: deterministic node --test backstop over the hooks, shared libraries, skills, dotfiles command line and repository checks
surfaces.driver: npm test from the repository root, the script package.json defines and .githooks/pre-commit runs; npm run test:ci is the subset CI runs

surfaces.name: rules and CLAUDE.md in a live session
surfaces.kind: Claude Code session that loads the global CLAUDE.md, rules, agents, skills and the synced settings hooks from the checkout
surfaces.driver: make a scratch git clone of the checkout under test, set HOME to a fresh temporary directory, run node <scratch clone>/scripts/dotfiles/cli.mjs install and sync with that HOME (as the CI job does into an empty home), then run claude -p with that HOME in a scratch git project and read the reply and the session transcript under the temporary HOME for the rule or hook behaviour under test

node_version.value: CI runs Node 26.x; this machine has node v26.10.0 and npm 11.19.1; package.json has no dependencies, so no install step is needed
node_version.recheck: read node-version in .github/workflows/ci.yml and run node --version

claude_cli.value: claude 2.1.300 at /opt/homebrew/bin/claude drives the live session surface

hook_runtime_tools.value: the hooks call python3, jq, graphify (~/.local/bin/graphify) and git; gitleaks is at /opt/homebrew/bin/gitleaks for the CI secret scan
hook_runtime_tools.recheck: command -v python3 jq graphify git gitleaks

live_config_links.value: ~/.claude CLAUDE.md, agents, hooks, keybindings.json, lib, output-styles, rules, skills and sounds link into the live clone ~/.windful-ocean, not this checkout; ~/.claude/docs and ~/.claude/notes link into this checkout; ~/.claude/settings.json is a real file

ci_scope.value: CI runs gitleaks over the pushed range, install, sync and check into an empty HOME, then npm run test:ci (block-destructive-bash and secret-scanner tests only); the full npm test runs locally
ci_scope.recheck: read .github/workflows/ci.yml and the scripts in package.json

active_git_hooks_path.value: core.hooksPath points at the logbook plugin's managed githooks directory under ~/.claude/plugins/data, not at .githooks

untracked_owner_files.value: the checkout holds untracked owner files, including .claude/hooks/tests/fanout-graph-wrapper, graphify-provision-banner and graphify-root-gate tests, .claude/lib/fanout, .claude/skills/fanout, graphify, synced and .trash, .claude/rules/common/graphify.md, .graphifyignore and docs/specs; npm test's globs pick up the untracked .test.mjs files

live_session_auth_under_temp_home.value: no: claude -p under a fresh temporary HOME or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR reports Not logged in, so a live session cannot be isolated from the owner's real configuration and that surface is unavailable
live_session_auth_under_temp_home.recheck: HOME=$(mktemp -d) claude -p 'reply ok' in a scratch directory and check it answers rather than asking to log in

npm_test_isolated_from_real_home.value: run with a temporary HOME from a scratch clone, the suite wrote nothing under the real ~/.claude or either checkout; the only real paths changed during the run were Claude Code's own backups and security log, written by the concurrently running session
npm_test_isolated_from_real_home.recheck: grep the test files for HOME, CLAUDE_OBSERVER_DIR and GRAPHIFY_OUT, then run npm test with HOME set to a temporary directory and compare git status and ~/.claude modification times before and after

suite_passes_on_main.value: npm test passed (684 tests, about 60 seconds) in a scratch clone of the committed checkout with a temporary HOME; the owner's untracked test files are not in a clone
suite_passes_on_main.recheck: npm test from the repository root

network_in_session_start_hooks.value: yes for read-only calls (git fetch and ls-remote, npm view, npm audit) from scratch clones; never push
network_in_session_start_hooks.recheck: ask the owner whether live-session and SessionStart trials may reach the npm registry and GitHub

lint_on_edit_eslint.value: no eslint is on PATH and the repository's package.json names no eslint, so lint-on-edit.sh finds no eslint project and exits silently
lint_on_edit_eslint.recheck: read .claude/hooks/lint-on-edit.sh for how it finds eslint and run command -v eslint npx

off_limits: running any hook, the dotfiles command line or a claude session with the real HOME, which acts on the owner's live ~/.claude settings, plugins, cache and observer log
running scripts/dotfiles/cli.mjs install, sync or cutover against the real HOME, or editing ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/settings.local.json or anything under ~/.claude
editing, pulling into or running scripts from the live clone ~/.windful-ocean
running .claude/hooks/branch-sync.mjs from this checkout or the live clone, since it fetches and fast-forwards the clone that holds it and the cwd repository
running graphify-provision.sh, graphify-refresh.sh or graphify update with cwd or CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in this checkout or any real repository, which writes graphify-out and starts a background build
running superpowers-cmd-hook-heal.sh or plugin-update-check.sh against the real HOME, which rewrite plugin cache files and write ~/.claude/cache
running claude plugin install, update or marketplace update
running lint-on-edit.sh on a file in this checkout, since eslint --fix rewrites it
appending to the real observer log under ~/.claude/observer; set CLAUDE_OBSERVER_DIR to a temporary directory
running scripts/install-hooks.sh or changing git config, including core.hooksPath, in this checkout
committing, stashing, resetting, cleaning or switching branches in this checkout, or touching its untracked files
pushing to or deleting branches on, or merging pull requests in, the GitHub repository SatanshuMishra/.windful-ocean, other than lighthouse's own profile commit and its FEATURE pull request
writing to the real logbook ledger or its refs/logbook refs
running .claude/skills/watch/scripts/setup.py without --check or --json, which installs packages through brew and writes ~/.config/watch/.env
